items.title: Does the $1.3 billion figure validate PayGuard's addressable problem?

queries.summary: The SEC table reports transaction losses of $1,337 million for 2025 and $1,114 million for 2024. It does not identify the amount attributable to AI-agent errors or preventable by PayGuard.

source.label: PayPal 2025 SEC segment reporting table
caveats: Company-wide transaction losses are not a measured addressable market or a demonstrated benefit of the prototype.

items.title: What directly overlaps the proposed PayGuard flow?

queries.summary: PayPal's AP2 publication describes verifiable intent and mandates. Warden and AGENT GATE publicly describe policy gates, approval, PayPal execution and audit or recovery mechanisms.

source.label: PayPal and public project descriptions
caveats: Public project descriptions establish concept overlap. Their implementation, security and eligibility for this event were not independently tested.

items.title: What supports and limits Assembly's technical case?

queries.summary: The retrieved abstract discusses combining language models with symbolic configuration methods and notes open scaling challenges.

source.label: Undermind research abstract
caveats: The research supports a technical direction. It does not establish Assembly's novelty, customer demand or measured performance.

queries.summary: Channel3 documents product variants, offers and category attributes. Hugging Face documents grammar-constrained structured generation. Neither establishes that critical compatibility facts will be complete and correct for our selected catalogue.

source.label: Official Channel3 and Hugging Face documentation
caveats: The Hugging Face connector was unavailable; public documentation was retrieved through Exa. Valid JSON does not independently establish factual accuracy. Product-discovery links do not confer merchant payment authority.

items.title: How should the first-prize recommendation be interpreted?
assumptions: The recommendation compares the two documented proposals for a two-person team, using the user's all-ten-sponsor requirement.
The 30,000-participant figure is the user's scenario; the number and quality of eligible competing projects are unknown.

queries.summary: The official rubric equally weights implementation, design, impact, innovation and presentation. Assembly is recommended as a qualitative judgment about a demonstrable product, not a numerical prediction or guaranteed win.

source.label: Official rules and judging criteria
caveats: No judge scores, deployment decision or causal prize-probability estimate is available for either proposal.
